animation-time.tooltip: How long the cube takes to rotate to the new workspace.

last-first-gap.description: Leave a gap between the last and first workspace
last-first-gap.tooltip: When enabled, the workspaces cover only half a circle, so switching from the last to the first workspace rotates back through all of them. When disabled, the workspaces form a closed cube and wrapping around takes the shortest way.

window-parallax.tooltip: How far windows float in front of the cube faces while it rotates. 0 keeps them flat on the faces.

hide-panels.description: Hide the panels while the cube is shown
hide-panels.tooltip: Draws the cube above the panels on the monitors where it rotates, during workspace switches and while dragging the cube. The panels themselves are not changed.

enable-panel-dragging.description: Rotate the cube by dragging an empty part of a panel
enable-panel-dragging.tooltip: Hold the left mouse button on a panel, away from any applet, and move the mouse. Moving sideways rotates the cube, moving up or down tilts it, and the scroll wheel zooms in and out.

mouse-rotation-speed.tooltip: How far the cube rotates for a given mouse movement.

do-explode.description: Spread the windows apart when the cube is tilted
